name: How To Be Human
source:
How To Be Human follows the thoughts of an alien girl who is struggling to fit in on earth. And it is absolutely definitely not an allegory for anything else.

[From [url=https://kazziecore.itch.io/how-to-be-human]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《如何成为人类》讲述了一个努力融入地球的外星女孩的想法。这绝对不是任何其他事物的寓言。

[来自[url=https://kazziecore.itch.io/how-to-be-human]itch.io[/url]]
